titulo: He watched the old man sleep for 7 nights 👁️ Part 1 #horror #shorts
descripcion:
Seven nights at midnight, he opened the old man's door. On the eighth, the eye was open.

Part 2: {when_next}.
Was he mad, or was it the eye?

Based on "The Tell-Tale Heart" by Edgar Allan Poe (public domain).
#edgarallanpoe #telltaleheart #horror #classicstories #shorts

lineas.texto: I loved the old man. It was his eye I could not stand.
Pale blue, like a vulture's. When it looked at me, my blood ran cold.
So for seven nights, at midnight, I opened his door. Slowly. So slowly.
And every night, the eye was closed.
On the eighth night, my thumb slipped on the lantern.
He sat up in bed and cried out. Who's there?
I did not move. I did not breathe. For one whole hour.
Then I opened the lantern, just a crack. The light fell on the eye. It was open.
And I heard it. A low, dull, quick sound. His heart.
